messages:
noah: Heads up — while triaging the KMS rekey job I noticed a class of requests that should have been rejected: embeddings requests accepted with tokens that only had chat scopes. Sounds like per-route scope enforcement dropped to a fallback path during the rotate. :eyes:
ana: whoa, can you paste the request/response logs you saw?
noah: pasted sanitized snippet below from the ingress log (stripped IDs):
```
REQ: POST /v1/models/encoder-3/embeddings
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx-chat-only,
  x-route: /v1/models/encoder-3/embeddings
}
RESP: 200 OK
Authz: decision=ALLOW reason="fallback-scope-match" token_scopes=["chat:generate"] required=["embed:generate"]
```
chris: fallback-scope-match — that sounds like the old behavior where missing KMS metadata triggered a permissive check. We deprecated that in the refactor though? :thinking:
maria: we shipped a `scope-refactor` last month that moved scope enforcement into the router, and it reads KMS key tags to map route->scope. If KMS metadata lookup fails we tried to use token-level scope intersection, but looks like the code did `if missing -> fallbackAllow` instead of `deny`.
anoah: repro steps I used: 1) rotate key on test tenant with rewrap, 2) simulate KMS delay by blocking metadata API, 3) send embeddings request with chat-only token -> 200.
sec-rotation-bot: @noah recorded KMS rotation job 2065432020 started, rewrap step completed at 2065432045, metadata propagation lag detected to 2065432068.
chris: OK confirmed. Likely bug: in authz middleware `checkScopes()` used: `if (!routeMeta) return legacyFallback(token)` where `legacyFallback` calls `allowIfTokenHasAnyRouteCompatibleScope()` which for embeddings allowed chat scopes because we have permissive mapping for older clients.
nana: that's a vuln because embeddings produce vector outputs that customers use for search — exposure could leak vector ops. We should triage as P1?
maria: agree P1 for affected tenants. Immediate mitigation options: 1) roll back refactor (risky), 2) hotfix to change `legacyFallback` to `deny` when routeMeta missing, 3) block all embedding model endpoints at the routing layer until patch.
noah: my preference: hotfix to stricter deny and a short-term route block for known embedding models for affected tenants.
eng-oncall: deploying patch to staging now: changing fallback to explicit deny; adding audit log fields. Will push to prod in 15m if staging passes.
chris: what audit fields are we adding? need enough to investigate later.
eng-oncall: adding `authz_decision`, `authz_reason`, `route_metadata_version`, and `kms_lookup_status` to access logs. Example: `authz_decision=DENY authz_reason=kms_meta_missing route_metadata_version=null kms_lookup_status=timeout`
noah: also add token_scopes and required_scopes to logs (sanitized), and a hashed token id for correlation.
maria: we should also make the KMS metadata lookup resilient: cache last-known-good mapping per-tenant for 10m and fallback to deny on cache miss instead of permissive allow. Add a background reconcile job to backfill metadata after rotation.
chris: can someone draft the incident action plan? Need rollout, customer impact comms, and retro items.
nana: quick plan draft: 1) prod hotfix: change fallback->deny + logs (owner: eng-oncall) 2) cache + reconcile + unit tests (owner: maria) 3) add e2e test that simulates KMS outage and verifies deny semantics (owner: chris) 4) rotate/verify keys for affected tenants + optional forced token reissue (owner: sec-rotation-bot / noah) 5) customer comms for impacted customers (owner: support)
eng-oncall: staging tests passed (authz now returns 403 when metadata missing). Rolling to canary 1/5 hosts.
sec-rotation-bot: flagged tenants with in-flight rotations: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c.
maria: after rollout we'll run a log scan: query `authz_reason=fallback-scope-match` across last 48h to enumerate leak windows and impacted tenants.
noah: also need a short-lived revoke: issue emergency rotation for any API keys observed in those logs and notify affected workspaces.
chris: retro items: - don't rely on permissive legacy mappings; - require explicit fail-closed for authz; - KMS metadata publish contract must have propagation SLAs; - add regression test in CI for rotation+authz.
maria: I'll open follow-ups: PRs for cache/reconcile, docs for KMS publish contract, and changelog entry.
noah: big thanks — nice triage everyone. I'll prep the customer notifications once we have the final impacted list. :lock:
